div.div: أَرْضٌ مُوتَثِجَةٌ (in the CK مُؤْتَثِجَةٌ [which is evidently a mistake]) Land abounding with herbage, or pasture, (S, K,) and with tangled trees; as also وَثِيجَةٌ: (ISh:) land of which the herbage is dense, thick, or compact. (TA.) [See also وَثِيخٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
